system_bucket.description: The current System Bucket (#734), ready or not; null while there is none.

awaiting_backup.description: A System Bucket exists but no metadata backup has succeeded in it yet: the kit is not offered (#734).

role.description: Explicit reference of the file: Current or the replacement in progress (pending). Never inferred from ordering.

storage_class_since.description: Class Entry: when the version entered storage_class (or expected_storage_class).

storage_class_since_estimated.description: The Class Entry is estimated from created_at and the Storage Plan, not recorded.

expected_storage_class.description: The colder class the Storage Plan expects by now, while the transition is not observed yet.

minimum_storage_until.description: When the Minimum Storage Duration of the class ends; null for a class without one.

DirectoryListItem.description: Directory protection counts as returned by /api/files browse mode. State is the most actionable observation, not Mixed.

reason.description: Bounded reconciliation reason, not an integrity outcome

aggregate_status.description: Directory aggregate readiness for this listing: ready, loading (no projection yet), or stale (showing prior projection while rebuild/dirty work converges).

ready_by.description: Expected end of the cloud restore: requested_at plus estimated_hours.

upload_verification.description: Override for new upload admissions; null inherits deployment default.

fixed_exclude_globs.description: Fixed noise exclusions applied to every Vault; read only.

queued.description: True when the Vault is held by another operation: the scan waits and starts as soon as the Vault is free (#759).

waiting_for.description: The operation holding the Vault, when queued.

waiting_since.description: When that operation took the Vault, when queued.

scan_queued.description: A requested full scan waits for the Vault (#759).

scan_waiting_for.description: The operation the queued scan waits for (null when the Vault is free).

scan_waiting_since.description: Since when that operation holds the Vault.

verify_bytes_read.description: Bytes read by the running verification, partial files included (#759).

retention_lock_days.description: The new Vault Bucket's Governance Retention Lock in days, or null for none (#736). It cannot be changed afterwards.

VaultFileListItem.description: Vault File protection observation: pending, protected, problem, unconfirmed, cloud_only, stopped (an upload the Owner stopped, kept out of automatic upload until the content changes, never pending), excluded (skipped by automatic upload, never pending) or unsupported (a symlink or special file that cannot be archived, never a problem).

in_excluded_folder.description: The file is inside an Excluded Folder: the Vault does not look there, so it keeps its last known state and is not observed.

current_version_id.description: Explicit Current Snapshot reference; null when the file has none.

pending_version_id.description: Explicit replacement in progress; never recoverable.

recoverable.description: Current exists, is verified and available.

stopped_since.description: When work that should move last made progress, once nothing has moved for five minutes; the expected finish is then null (#759).

UploadThroughput.description: Measured speeds of a Vault's two adoption phases, from in-memory samples lost at restart (#755). Bytes per second; null until measured.

ExpectedFinish.description: The later of the active phases at their average speed, and the phase that limits it (#755).

FileRecovery.description: Recovery in progress of a cloud-only file (#646): its Job and the cloud restore, which continues and is charged after the Job is stopped.

active.description: A Recovery Job is in progress; false when only the cloud restore continues or a restored copy is readable.

ready_by.description: Request instant plus the tier's restore hours; an estimate.

expires_at.description: End of the readable restored copy.

retained_count.description: Locked versions left after a run (#736): the request waits for them.

retained_until.description: When the last of them can be deleted.

next_attempt_at.description: When the deletion runs again for them.

delete_bucket.description: The Owner asked to delete the empty Vault Bucket too (#739).

beyond_minimum.description: Schedule only duplicates beyond their Minimum Storage Duration (#731).

held.description: With beyond_minimum on: duplicates the next run keeps until their minimum ends.

MinimumStorageDeletion.description: Files of a deletion still within their Minimum Storage Duration when it executes, and what deleting them then still bills: a Cost Estimate from AWS list prices (#731).

savings_from.description: When the last Minimum Storage Duration of these files ends: deleting from then saves.

estimated_count.description: How many of them have an estimated Class Entry.

MinimumStorageSummary.description: Minimum Storage Duration of a Vault's versions (#731): a Cost Estimate from AWS list prices.

within.description: Versions still within the Minimum Storage Duration.

beyond.description: Versions beyond it, or in a class without one.

releases.description: Month by month (YYYY-MM, UTC), the versions whose Minimum Storage Duration ends.

estimated_count.description: Versions with a minimum whose Class Entry is estimated from the Storage Plan.

VaultBucketStatus.description: A Vault's bucket (#735). While a new Vault is provisioning, the state of its Vault Bucket creation: creating, failed, or settling (verified, active at active_at, 15 minutes after the verification).

active_at.description: When a verified bucket's Vault becomes active (settling only).

active_in_seconds.description: Seconds until active_at, never negative (settling only).

VaultCreationCancelled.description: A cancelled Vault creation (#735). The Vault left the catalog; a bucket already created is not deleted: bucket_left says whether it was created (created) or an attempt may have reached AWS (possible).

estimate.description: The catalog's versions not known to be missing, by class, with a Cost Estimate from AWS list prices.

status.description: available: a data point is saved. pending: not read yet. no_data, access_denied, failed: the last read's outcome, with nothing saved. shared_bucket: an older Vault on a shared bucket, never read. provisioning: the Vault Bucket is being created.

next_read_after.description: When the Vault Bucket is read again: 24 hours after an ok read, 6 hours after any other outcome.

day.description: UTC day of the newest data point.

bytes.description: The objects' own bytes in this class.

overhead_bytes.description: Bytes AWS bills on top of the objects of this class.

billed_as.description: The storage class whose price AWS applies to these bytes.

measured.description: Daily S3 storage metrics read from CloudWatch GetMetricStatistics (#737).

VaultCloudUsage.description: A Vault's cloud usage (#737): the catalog's Cost Estimate next to the CloudWatch sizes of its Vault Bucket.

BillingExportStatus.description: The AWS Data Exports (CUR 2.0) billing export and every known bucket's Billed Cost (#738). Never a Cost Explorer figure.

state.description: unavailable: no System Bucket; checking: the first look is running; not_configured: nothing under the prefix; waiting: the export exists without a first manifest; ok: read; error: unreadable (see error_code).

bucket.description: The System Bucket the export is delivered to.

prefix.description: The S3 path prefix of the export in the System Bucket.

read_at.description: When FrostVault last read the export (only when ok).

exported_at.description: When AWS delivered the newest manifest that was read.

data_through.description: The newest usage end in the export, never after exported_at.

stale.description: ok but not up to date: the export AWS delivered is over 3 days old, or the current month is missing after the 3rd.

error_code.description: Why the export could not be read (state error); the UI translates it. s3_unreachable, s3_throttled and s3_server_error are retried after 6 hours, the others after a day.

error_detail.description: An S3 action and AWS error code, column or currency names: never a provider message.

periods.description: Billing periods read, newest first; empty unless state is ok.

total.description: Every row of the period: Vaults and installation.

vaults_total.description: The Vault rows only: FrostVault's Vault Buckets, not the whole AWS bill.

categories.description: Billed amounts by category, in the billing currency; every category is present.

credits.description: Credits, refunds and discounts of the bucket (negative).

installation.description: The System Bucket and shared buckets of older Vaults: not attributed to one Vault.

categories.description: Billed amounts by category, in the billing currency; every category is present.

credits.description: Credits, refunds and discounts of the bucket (negative).

VaultBilledCost.description: A Vault's Billed Cost from the billing export (#738), a block of its cloud usage next to the Cost Estimate (#737).

state.description: unavailable: no System Bucket; checking: the first look is running; not_configured: nothing under the prefix; waiting: the export exists without a first manifest; ok: read; error: unreadable (see error_code).

bucket.description: The System Bucket the export is delivered to.

prefix.description: The S3 path prefix of the export in the System Bucket.

read_at.description: When FrostVault last read the export (only when ok).

exported_at.description: When AWS delivered the newest manifest that was read.

data_through.description: The newest usage end in the export, never after exported_at.

stale.description: ok but not up to date: the export AWS delivered is over 3 days old, or the current month is missing after the 3rd.

error_code.description: Why the export could not be read (state error); the UI translates it. s3_unreachable, s3_throttled and s3_server_error are retried after 6 hours, the others after a day.

error_detail.description: An S3 action and AWS error code, column or currency names: never a provider message.

shared.description: The Vault is in a shared bucket: it has no Billed Cost of its own and periods is empty; the bucket is an installation row of GET /api/billing-export.

periods.description: Newest first; empty unless state is ok, and for a shared bucket.

categories.description: Billed amounts by category, in the billing currency; every category is present.

credits.description: Credits, refunds and discounts of the bucket (negative).

RetentionLockPreview.description: Files of a deletion a Governance Retention Lock still holds when it executes (#736). Dates are estimates: each version's creation plus the bucket default days. They are deleted from that date, never earlier.

locked_from.description: When the first of them can be deleted.

locked_until.description: When the last of them can be deleted.

RetentionLockStatus.description: A Vault's Governance Retention Lock, fixed at creation (#736), and the superseded versions it holds back until their RetainUntilDate.

failed_count.description: Retained Versions whose last deletion failed (#749).

failed_attempts.description: The most consecutive failed deletions of one of them.

last_error.description: The S3 error code of the most recent failure.

DiskListingEntry.description: An entry read from disk inside an Excluded Folder: not catalogued, not protected.

ExcludedFolderListing.description: One Vault level read from disk (#754): Excluded Folders of a catalogued level, or the entries of an Excluded Folder.

excluded_by.description: The folder rule that covers this directory; null outside an Excluded Folder.

own_rule.description: path/** for a folder, the exact path for a file; null when the path holds glob characters.

rules.description: Other exclude globs that exclude the item.

fixed.description: Fixed noise exclusions that match the item.

not_included.description: The include globs do not match the item.

own_rule.description: path/** for a folder, the exact path for a file; null when the path holds glob characters.

rules.description: Other exclude globs that exclude the item.

fixed.description: Fixed noise exclusions that match the item.

not_included.description: The include globs do not match the item.

folder_rule.description: Removing the rule makes the Vault look inside the folder again with a full scan.

complete.description: False when the disk walk stopped at its time budget: the counts are a minimum.
